purpose: Retained blocked draft of the physical coherent H1/L1/V1 GW170817 successor. An independent pre-response audit found that the 128-second window places merger inside the Tukey end taper; this draft is never response-authorized.

post_freeze_changes_allowed: implementation repairs that do not change data, formulae, priors, grids, thresholds, seeds, or decisions
fail-closed runtime compatibility repairs recorded append-only

predecessor_v3.retention_rule: retain the v3 approximate TaylorF2 residual results, thresholds, failures, and caveats byte-for-byte; v4 is a successor, not a replacement

lalsuite.runtime_distribution: PyPI manylinux_2_28 cp312 wheel, exact version 7.26.15

event.sky_rule: fixed to the optical counterpart/NGC 4993 rather than inferred from strain

psd_robustness.method: Welch Hann 16 s, 50 percent overlap, constant detrend, median average
Welch Hann 16 s, 50 percent overlap, constant detrend, median average

preprocessing.psd_decision_rule: the published PSD is primary; all three off-source alternatives are mandatory robustness outputs and cannot select a preferred result

coherent_likelihood.fourier_convention: numpy rfft exp(-2 pi i f t); a positive detector arrival time multiplies the LAL frequency-domain waveform by exp(-2 pi i f t)
coherent_likelihood.detector_response: h_d(f)=[Fplus_d hplus(f)+Fcross_d hcross(f)] exp(-2 pi i f [tc+Delta_t_d]) C_d(f)
coherent_likelihood.antenna_and_delay: lal.ComputeDetAMResponse and lal.TimeDelayFromEarthCenter evaluated at the frozen sky and geocentric GPS time
coherent_likelihood.inner_product: (a|b)_d=4 Delta_f Re sum a*(f)b(f)/S_d(f) on each detector band
coherent_likelihood.event_coherence: one source, sky, geocentric time, phase, distance, inclination, and polarization for all detectors; no detector-specific complex amplitudes or detector-specific event times
coherent_likelihood.calibration_model: C_d(f)=M_d(f) exp[a_d sigma_logM_d(f)+i p_d sigma_phase_d(f)], with linear interpolation of the published event envelope, a_d and p_d standard-normal nuisance truncated at plus/minus 3
coherent_likelihood.calibration_shape_rule: sigma_logM=(log upper magnitude-log lower magnitude)/2; sigma_phase=(upper phase-lower phase)/2

nuisance_priors.prior_use: report both unpenalized maximum log likelihood and MAP log posterior; model comparison uses unpenalized likelihood and the same nuisance count for every branch

optimizer.convergence_gate: all objective values finite and best-minus-worst unpenalized 2 log likelihood across the three seeds no greater than 2.0 for GR and every branch
optimizer.failure_action: retain all seed results; label the affected model NONCONVERGED and forbid an empirical-support claim

zero_noise_gr_control.pass: GR is minimum BIC; chirp mass error <=0.0015 solar mass; geocentric time error <=0.002 s; network recovered SNR fraction >=0.90

target_free_gates.branch_injection_rule: at network SNR 32 and frozen GR source/nuisance parameters, fit all five branch transfer laws plus GR; injected branch must have minimum BIC and its first amplitude-like parameter must be recovered within max(25 percent relative, 0.05 absolute)
target_free_gates.failure_action: if either injection gate fails, real-data fitting may run as a retained diagnostic but all propagation interpretation is IDENTIFIABILITY_BLOCKED

real_data_gr_gate.failure_action: retain all results but label every propagation comparison INVALID_GR_CONTROL

multiple_comparisons.primary_ranking: BIC=-2 logLmax+k log(n), with n equal to twice the number of retained complex frequency bins across detectors and k equal to 17 common parameters plus branch extras
multiple_comparisons.likelihood_ratio_diagnostic: chi-square survival probability with branch extra-parameter count, followed by Bonferroni min(1,5p); marked asymptotic/non-decisive for boundary and nonidentified-null branches

time_slides.rule: H1 fixed; circularly phase-shift L1 by +0.25 k seconds and V1 by -0.375 k seconds for k=1..31
time_slides.fit_rule: condition intrinsic source and calibration parameters on the primary GR MAP; refit common phase, time, distance, inclination, polarization, and every branch parameter
time_slides.statistic: maximum Delta(2 logL) across all five branches
time_slides.interpretation: conditional empirical familywise diagnostic, not an unconditional event posterior

multiple_comparisons.promotion_rule: requires valid target-free gates, valid real GR gate, convergence, DeltaBIC<=-6 relative to GR, Bonferroni diagnostic p<0.05, conditional time-slide familywise p<0.05, and the same branch sign under every PSD and waveform robustness replay

robustness.replay_rule: begin from each primary MAP and re-optimize every parameter with deterministic L-BFGS-B; failures retained

separate_judgments.empirical_fit: calculated likelihood, BIC, PSD/waveform replays, detector contributions, and time-slide statistic only
separate_judgments.identifiability: target-free confusion matrix, recovery errors, convergence spread, and local finite-difference curvature eigenvalues
separate_judgments.theory_health: separate audit of covariance, causality, stability, conservation/receiver, GR/static limits, and complete action; empirical fit cannot override it
separate_judgments.novelty: separate prior-art mapping; the transfer shapes are phenomenological and no historical novelty is presumed
separate_judgments.publication: no one-event development result is publication-ready without an unchanged independent BNS holdout
